deskNodeFitTitle: Should this computer run a node?

@deskNodeFitTitle.description: Title of the local node fit check: a dialog shown when the user picks the local node (the node program on this computer) in Settings > Node, and from Help.

deskNodeFitDescription: Two questions. This can be changed any time in Settings › Node.

@deskNodeFitDescription.description: Local node fit check: line under the title. 'Settings › Node' names the settings page; keep the › sign.

deskNodeFitOpenQ: How long is the wallet usually open?

@deskNodeFitOpenQ.description: Local node fit check: first question, above three choices.

@deskNodeFitOpenDay.description: Local node fit check: answer to 'How long is the wallet usually open?'. Short, it sits in a segmented control.

@deskNodeFitOpenHours.description: Local node fit check: answer to 'How long is the wallet usually open?'. Short, it sits in a segmented control.

@deskNodeFitOpenMinutes.description: Local node fit check: answer to 'How long is the wallet usually open?'. Short, it sits in a segmented control.

@deskNodeFitOpenHint.description: Local node fit check: hint beside the first question, from the time the wallet was open over the last days, counted on this computer only. {hours} is a whole number of hours. 'h' is the short form of hours.

deskNodeFitOpenHintUnder: Recently: under an hour a day

@deskNodeFitOpenHintUnder.description: Local node fit check: hint beside the first question when the wallet was open less than an hour a day over the last days.

@deskNodeFitNetQ.description: Local node fit check: second question, about the internet connection, above two choices.

@deskNodeFitNetFree.description: Local node fit check: answer to 'Your connection': unlimited data.

@deskNodeFitNetMetered.description: Local node fit check: answer to 'Your connection': a plan with a data limit or a phone hotspot.

@deskNodeFitNetHintFree.description: Local node fit check, Windows only: hint beside 'Your connection' when Windows reports the connection is not metered.

@deskNodeFitNetHintMetered.description: Local node fit check, Windows only: hint beside 'Your connection' when Windows reports a metered connection.

@deskNodeFitDisk.description: Local node fit check: label of the disk space line.

@deskNodeFitDiskFree.description: Local node fit check: disk space line. {free} is the free space on the drive (e.g. '212 GB'), {chain} the size of the blockchain on disk (e.g. '5 GB').

@deskNodeFitDiskUnknown.description: Local node fit check: disk space line when the free space cannot be read. {chain} is the size of the blockchain on disk (e.g. '5 GB').

deskNodeFitFound: Found {size} of chain data on this computer. It can be reused.

@deskNodeFitFound.description: Local node fit check: line under the disk space when blockchain data from another Epic node or wallet is on this computer. {size} e.g. '4.2 GB'.

@deskNodeFitGood.description: Local node fit check: verdict title when the wallet is open most of the day.

deskNodeFitGoodText: The node stays in sync while the wallet is open, keeps lookups private and helps the network.

@deskNodeFitGoodText.description: Local node fit check: verdict text under 'Good fit'. The node runs only while the app is open; do not suggest it runs when the app is closed.

deskNodeFitWait: Works, with a wait each time

@deskNodeFitWait.description: Local node fit check: verdict title when the wallet is open an hour or two.

deskNodeFitWaitText: Each time the wallet opens, the node first catches up on the blocks it missed.

@deskNodeFitWaitText.description: Local node fit check: verdict text under 'Works, with a wait each time'.

@deskNodeFitPublic.description: Local node fit check: verdict title when the wallet is open only a few minutes at a time.

deskNodeFitPublicText: Short visits go to catching up: the wallet feels slower and the network gains little.

@deskNodeFitPublicText.description: Local node fit check: verdict text under 'A public node fits better'.

@deskNodeFitMetered.description: Local node fit check: verdict title when the connection is metered.

deskNodeFitMeteredText: The first sync downloads about {size}. Start it on a connection without a data limit.

@deskNodeFitMeteredText.description: Local node fit check: verdict text under 'Mind the first download'. {size} e.g. '5 GB'.

@deskNodeFitNoSpace.description: Local node fit check: verdict title when the drive has too little free space for the blockchain.

deskNodeFitNoSpaceText: The chain takes about {chain}, and {floor} more must stay free on this drive.

@deskNodeFitNoSpaceText.description: Local node fit check: verdict text under 'Not enough free space'. {chain} and {floor} are sizes, e.g. '5 GB'.

deskNodeFitCapDay: In sync almost all the time

@deskNodeFitCapDay.description: Local node fit check: caption beside the picture of the node and its peers, when the wallet is open most of the day.

deskNodeFitCapDaySub: And passing blocks on to others

@deskNodeFitCapDaySub.description: Local node fit check: second line of the caption 'In sync almost all the time'.

@deskNodeFitCapHours.description: Local node fit check: caption beside the picture of the node, when the wallet is open an hour or two.

deskNodeFitCapHoursSub: Then stays in sync while open

@deskNodeFitCapHoursSub.description: Local node fit check: second line of the caption 'Catches up at each visit'.

@deskNodeFitCapMinutes.description: Local node fit check: caption beside the picture of the node, when the wallet is open a few minutes.

deskNodeFitCapMinutesSub: The wallet closes before the node is in sync

@deskNodeFitCapMinutesSub.description: Local node fit check: second line of the caption 'Mostly catching up'.

@deskNodeFitInSync.description: Local node fit check: legend of the green part of the ring in the picture. Lowercase.

@deskNodeFitCatchingUp.description: Local node fit check: legend of the striped amber part of the ring in the picture. Lowercase.

@deskNodeFitThisComputer.description: Local node fit check: label in the middle of the picture, under the computer icon. Lowercase.

@deskNodeFitChipPrivate.description: Local node fit check: small tag in the picture, lit when it applies: the wallet asks its own node, not a public one.

@deskNodeFitChipNetwork.description: Local node fit check: small tag in the picture, lit when it applies: the node passes blocks on to other nodes.

@deskNodeFitChipInSync.description: Local node fit check: small tag in the picture, lit when it applies: the node is in sync for most of the time the wallet is open.

@deskNodeFitDownload.description: Local node fit check: small tag in the picture when the connection is metered. {size} e.g. '5 GB'.

@deskNodeFitDontShow.description: Local node fit check: checkbox above the buttons. When ticked, picking the local node skips this check; it stays in Help.

@deskNodeFitStart.description: Local node fit check: button that starts the node program on this computer.

@deskNodeFitStartAnyway.description: Local node fit check: secondary button when the verdict advises against the local node; starts it all the same.

@deskNodeFitKeepPublic.description: Local node fit check: main button when the verdict advises against the local node; closes and keeps the current node.

@deskNodeFitNotNow.description: Local node fit check: button that closes it and keeps the current node.

deskNodeFitInUse: The local node is in use. Its settings are in Settings › Node.

@deskNodeFitInUse.description: Local node fit check opened from Help while the local node already runs: line above the Close button. Keep the › sign.

@deskNodeFitOpenCheck.description: Help, topic 'Should this computer run a node?': button that opens the local node fit check.

@deskNodeFitStarted.description: Toast title after the local node is started.

deskNodeFitStartedText: The wallet works through {host} until the node is in sync.

@deskNodeFitStartedText.description: Toast text after the local node is started, when another node is used while it syncs. {host} is a node address, e.g. node.example.com.

deskNodeFitStartedAlone: Balances and sending wait until the node is in sync.

@deskNodeFitStartedAlone.description: Toast text after the local node is started, when no other node is used while it syncs.
